sources.observed: September2 announcement: 2026–27 one-year student-facing generative-AI moratorium 2-K through8; companion chatbots prohibited all grades; limited supervised high-school pilots and twice-yearly literacy modules. A school policy, not a national or home-use ban. Teachers may use compliant tools for planning/operations; exceptions include assistive technology for disabilities, multilingual learners and career readiness.

July7 proposed rule, docket EPA-HQ-OAR-2025-1212. Remove federal public-participation minimum for state/local minor NSR programs; agencies may retain requirements. Major NSR requirements unchanged. Includes synthetic minor categories. Published comment deadline August21; no extension verified. Sections summary, II.A and scope read; official PDF not yet checked.
EPA current index still lists July1 signed minor NSR public-participation action as proposed.

Official PDF recovered through Federal Register API pdf_url, 14pages. Page0 EPA summary and August21 comment deadline match XML.
